{{Top}}
'''Substation 9-4''' was a [[Rail jet/Legends|rail jet]] station on the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']].

During the [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends#Mission aboard the Malevolence|unsuccessful attempt to apprehend]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] stopped at this station shortly before the [[H-type Nubian yacht/Legends|H-type Nubian yacht]] of Senator Amidala exploded. The station was destroyed along with the rest of the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']] when the ship crashed into the [[Dead Moon of Antar/Legends|Dead Moon of Antar]].
